permissions.name: dsh-windows-acl-preflight.process.spawn
permissions.reason: Run icacls.exe, whoami.exe and powershell.exe to read and repair workspace ACLs before a confined command starts.

permissions.name: dsh-windows-acl-preflight.workspace.acl
permissions.reason: Grant the signed-in user Full control on the workspace root and propagate DSH's capability ACE plus the Low integrity label to pre-existing workspace subtrees.

x-display.title: Windows ACL preflight
x-display.description: Repairs the workspace ACL that DSH's Windows sandbox requires, so pwsh works in a new workspace under workspace-write with no escalation approval.
